title: Create Agent step policy and capability adapter
purpose: Adapt generic PlanStep execution into the existing ToolRouter, PolicyEvaluator, approval token, and capability lease flow.
scope: Translate PlanStep into SemanticToolCall and PolicyRequest.
Route tool names and normalized params through ToolRouter before policy evaluation.
Use PolicyEvaluator as authoritative risk classifier, regardless of planner risk hints.
Bind approval tokens to exact actor, tool, resource, parameter hash, expiry, and policy version.
Return allowed, denied, or pause-for-approval decisions to AgentCore without preparing effects on denial or pause.
Expose reusable diagnostics for why a step was denied or paused.
acceptance_criteria: Planner risk hints cannot downgrade policy risk.
Unknown tools and shell.exec are denied before effect preparation.
Paused steps return AwaitingApproval without EffectPrepared.
Allowed steps receive lease metadata suitable for sandbox compilation and audit.
verification: Attempt to mark shell.exec as read-only and confirm denial.
Attempt to reuse approval with changed params and confirm denial.
Inspect audit records for policy version and parameter hash.
risk_notes: The adapter must not become a second policy engine; it only translates AgentCore requests into the existing evaluator.
